Artistic filter "Graphic Pen" (movie-maker-reference.md §3, possibly not visible in 2.1); approximated as a thresholded Sobel edge sketch (black-on-white line art); GUID not verifiable without a reference installation

Artistic filter "Watercolor" (EffectID 40, movie-maker-reference.md §4, named there as a Kuwahara filter); approximated here as 3x3 box smoothing + posterize, reusing the already-validated blur and posterize shaders' maths, rather than implementing a true Kuwahara filter; GUID not verifiable without a reference installation
